study.title: A U-Net Improved Version for Crop and Weed Segmentation from Aerial Images
study.short_title: Tobacco: dual-head vegetation-crop U-Net; mIoU 0.9225, PA 0.979, 22.9 Im/s

segmentation.domain: Single-stage U-Net variant for tobacco crop vs weed segmentation in aerial (drone) imagery: dual-headed output predicts vegetation and crop masks in one pass, with weed regions derived logically as vegetation minus crops (hierarchical residual); deep supervision + Vegetation Global Context bottleneck block + spatial attention on skip features
models_tested: Proposed U-Net variant with ConvNeXt V2 Tiny / MambaVision-T / FastViT_S12 / FastViT_SA24 / RepViT-M2 encoders (ImageNet-pretrained)
External works on same data: [38] two-stage tobacco-weed U-Net, [39] EfficientNet two-stage U-Net (authors' prior), [27] SegFormer-like architecture
segmentation.best_model: Proposed U-Net with ConvNeXt V2 Tiny encoder @ 480x352: IoU crops 0.8990, IoU weeds 0.8843, mIoU 0.9225, Dice crops 0.9424, Dice weeds 0.9372, Overall PA 0.9790, Kappa 0.9586, 22.90 Im/s, 32.52M params, 17.93 GFLOPs. Fastest variant FastViT_S12 @ 256x256: 64.81 Im/s (mIoU 0.8916, PA 0.9665)

dataset.name: Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan tobacco-field aerial dataset (Mendeley 'Tobacco Aerial Dataset'): 210 images across 8 campaigns, DJI Mavic Mini at avg 4 m altitude, 1920x1080; 480x352 patches with manual 3-class masks
dataset.note: 3 classes: background (0), tobacco (1), weed (2). Mavic Mini 1/2.3-inch CMOS, f/2.8, 3-axis gimbal. The study fixed mask/patch misnaming via HSV green-filter + k-NN mask rematching (no mask content modification) and excluded the noisy 2nd campaign. Split (after exclusion): 80% train (1267) / 10% val (158) / 10% test (159). Corrected dataset + test split on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.19422418).

segmentation.backbone: U-Net encoder-decoder with ConvNeXt V2 Tiny/MambaVision-T/FastViT/RepViT backbones; Vegetation Global Context block at bottleneck (masked global pooling + channel gating, r=4); spatial attention on skip connections; deep supervision (aux heads at each decoder stage, discarded at inference); loss = Dice + BCE + Boundary Dice + crop-recall terms (lambdaV 1.3/C 1.6/W 1, aux 0.05); weed threshold 0.3. PyTorch 2.9.0 + timm 1.0.22, AdamW, cosine annealing, 50 epochs, lr 1e-4

mIoU.quote: Backbone ... IoU Crops IoU Weeds mIoU ... ConvNeXt V2 Tiny 480x352 ... 0.8990 0.8843 0.9225
mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU over the three classes (background/tobacco/weed) for the best model (ConvNeXt V2 Tiny @480x352, 0.3 binarization threshold). Same architecture at 256x256: mIoU 0.9002. FastViT_S12@480x352 0.9031, RepViT-M2 0.9058, MambaVision-T 0.9046.

mPA.ambiguity: Only overall pixel accuracy reported, not class-averaged.

F1.ambiguity: Per-class Dice (equivalent to F1 for binary masks) reported instead of explicit F1 (e.g. Dice crops 0.9424, Dice weeds 0.9372).

Dice.quote: best scores of 94.24% Dice for crop segmentation and 93.72% for weeds
Dice.ambiguity: Per-class Dice for the best model (ConvNeXt V2 Tiny @480x352): crops 0.9424, weeds 0.9372 (mean ~0.9398). Weed Dice highest among all backbones at 480x352; crop Dice slightly higher at 256x256 (0.9446).

PA.quote: ConvNeXt V2 Tiny 480 x 352 ... 0.9790 (Overall Accuracy); 0.9586 (Overall Kappa)
PA.ambiguity: Overall pixel accuracy of best model (ConvNeXt V2 Tiny @480x352) = 0.9790. FastViT_S12@480x352 0.9728; RepViT-M2 0.9724; MambaVision-T 0.9718.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed class evaluated via IoU 0.8843 and Dice 0.9372, not F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop class evaluated via IoU 0.8990 and Dice 0.9424, not F1.

edge.device: Desktop PC: Intel i5-9300H CPU, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti GPU, 8 GB RAM

fps.ambiguity: Inference speed of the best-accuracy model (ConvNeXt V2 Tiny @480x352) on GTX 1660 Ti desktop - edge.reported=false. Timing includes full pipeline (read, resize, normalize, threshold). Fastest variant FastViT_S12 @256x256: 64.81 Im/s (45+ Im/s at 480x352). Mask2Former baseline only 4.47 Im/s.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Derived as 1000/22.90 from the reported throughput of the best model - desktop GTX 1660 Ti, not edge hardware. FastViT_S12 @256x256 would give ~15.4 ms.

params_M.quote: Ours, with ConvNeXt V2 Tiny 32.52 M 17.93 G
params_M.ambiguity: Structural param count for the best backbone (ConvNeXt V2 Tiny); edge.reported=false. Mask2Former 47.40M for comparison.

gflops.quote: Ours, with ConvNeXt V2 Tiny 32.52 M 17.93 G
gflops.ambiguity: Structural FLOPs at 480x352 input; Mask2Former 46.05 G for comparison.

issues: edge.reported=false: all throughput on GTX 1660 Ti desktop (i5-9300H, 8 GB); 'well-suited for real-time deployment' is qualitative (no edge/UAV hardware measured).

Best accuracy: ConvNeXt V2 Tiny @480x352 (mIoU 0.9225, PA 0.9790, Kappa 0.9586, 22.90 Im/s); fastest: FastViT_S12 @256x256 (64.81 Im/s, mIoU 0.8916). Weed class is derived (vegetation minus crop), not directly predicted; binarization threshold 0.3.
Dataset: Mardan (Pakistan) tobacco-field drone data, 480x352 patches; noisy 2nd campaign excluded; mask misnaming repaired by HSV+k-NN rematching; corrected set on Zenodo.
Outperforms prior two-stage approaches ([38], [39]) and a Mask2Former (Swin-T) baseline (4.47 Im/s, 46.05 GFLOPs) on same data.
